disclaimer.p1: These calculators are for learning and planning. They are not financial, tax or legal advice.
disclaimer.p2: Results are estimates. Real returns change every year and can be lower than the rate you enter. Tax rules and rates change, and the rules shown here are examples with a date and a source. Check the source before you rely on them.
disclaimer.p3: Talk to a qualified adviser before you make a financial decision. We are not responsible for any loss caused by using this website.

pages.aboutP1: Finance Calculators is a free set of money calculators. It starts with the SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan) calculator and grows to cover investing, loans, retirement and property.
pages.aboutP2: Every calculator runs fully in your browser. There is no server and no account. The formulas are in a separate, tested package so they can be reused and checked.
pages.aboutP3: We write in simple English, and each page explains the formula behind the numbers.
pages.privacyP1: We do not collect, store or send the numbers you enter. All calculations happen in your browser.
pages.privacyP2: Your inputs are written to the page address only when you copy a share link. Saved scenarios, if any, stay in this browser.
pages.privacyP3: Analytics are off by default. If they are turned on, we use a privacy-friendly tool that counts page views without personal data.
